title: Setting Core Charge to 0 on a part with a core still shows the Core Charge Warning
custom_steps:
1. Edit X
  2. Type 0 in Core Charge
  3. Cancel the warning
custom_expected:
1. Dialog opens
  2. "Core Charge Warning" with "Setting core charge to zero will remove it from existing transactions. Continue?"
  3. Core Charge returns to 15; nothing saved
